items.claim: Gage Young is very hittable, overextends, and looks for finishes, which allows opponents to find his head.
items.quote: Problem is, he can be hittable. He is very offensively sound and dangerous, but he overextends, he looks for finishes, and you can go ahead and find his head.

items.claim: Gage Young borders on looking uncomfortable in grappling exchanges.
items.quote: He's got random takedowns, there's some decent grappling in there, but he borderline looks uncomfortable in the grappling exchanges.

items.claim: Stan is fast, long, and insanely aggressive.
items.quote: Stan is fast, he's long as hell, he's insanely aggressive

items.claim: Jamall Emmers has a 53% takedown accuracy and an 81% takedown defense.
items.quote: He has a 53% takedown accuracy with an 81% takedown defense.

items.claim: Jamall Emmers struggles a little bit off his back if he is taken down.
items.quote: If he's taken down, he can struggle a little bit off his back, but he has good offensive wrestling.

items.claim: Jamall Emmers has plenty of one-punch knockout power with two of his last three fights coming by knockout.
items.quote: He also has plenty of one-punch knockout power with two of his last three fights coming by knockout.

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast lands more than six significant strikes per minute.
items.quote: he's landing more than six significant strikes per minute.

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast has an 86% takedown defense.
items.quote: He's got a very good 86% takedown defense.

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast absorbs six significant strikes per minute.

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast was recently knocked out cold by a head kick from Khon Salkeld.
items.quote: Most recently, he was hit in the head by Khon Salkeld and it put him out cold.

items.claim: Elise Reed struggles to get off the fence or off her back if she is taken down.
items.quote: She does struggle to get off the fence or off her back if she's taken down.
What is also not great is his cardio. It's a bit inconsistent.
